profile.headline: Software Engineer at Nava
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Go. Experienced in AWS serverless architectures, GraphQL APIs, and complex third-party system integrations. Proven ability to deliver reliable production systems and coordinate incident response in distributed environments.

Tech Stack: React • TypeScript • Node.js • Go • GraphQL • AWS • PostgreSQL
